assertions.subject: Fungal vertebral osteomyelitis
assertions.quote: Fungal vertebral osteomyelitis, although rare, can occur in patients from endemic regions (eg, histoplasmosis and blastomycosis)

assertions.subject: Fungal vertebral osteomyelitis
assertions.quote: Fungal vertebral osteomyelitis, although rare, can occur in patients from endemic regions (eg, histoplasmosis and blastomycosis), immunocompromised individuals (eg, Aspergillus fumigatus), IV drug users, and those with indwelling intravenous catheters (eg, Candida and Aspergillus)
